column1: # Viractal: Will You Trust Your Party? on Android (keys in docs/ARCHITECTURE.md "Game profiles on Android")
# Unity on SDK 21; game.tsv started as upstream's provisional profile and was checked by hand.
# On the Y700 (2026-10-25): title screen at 30 fps, and past it into the Game Room tutorial; play beyond that is untested.
# Known gaps: 1,894 of its 25,464 shaders (1,836 pixel) fail in the translator, so a few draws and dispatches are skipped: Ryujinx's SPIR-V
# GenerateCall (CodeGen/Spirv/Instructions.cs) takes an out argument that is no local of the caller (KeyNotFoundException in GetLocalPointer).
# The fix is in the shared translation chain, whose lock (dmsh_chain.lock) also fingerprints Apple's Metal compiler: it is made on a Mac, for every game.
# Advanced blend mode 21 is not implemented.
